title: Evidence-Horizon Sensitivity in Longitudinal Runtime Evidence
discovery_statement: A longitudinal claim can be deterministic at a given evidence horizon yet fail to remain invariant as the admissible evidence horizon expands.

provisional_principle.name: Horizon Non-Monotonicity Principle
provisional_principle.statement: Additional evidence does not necessarily strengthen an existing longitudinal claim. New admissible evidence may preserve, strengthen, weaken, relocate, withdraw, or reissue a previously admissible finding.

empirical_basis.experiment: Waypoint / PsiGuard T1-T275 blind prospective prefix replay

claim_boundary: Internal discovery record from one long-horizon trajectory. Requires cross-case replication before elevation to a general scientific principle.
